channel.title: Pier & Point · UCSF Illinois Street Garage
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for UCSF Illinois Street Garage (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · UCSF Illinois Street Garage: The Illinois Street Garage was shown as opening on May 15, 2023 at 590 Illinois Street, from a UCSF page that could not be read. A February 2023 SF YIMBY article already calls the garage open and gives 499 Illinois Street, so the garage is now shown as open by February 8, 2023, and both the opening date and the address are listed as unresolved.

item.title: Correction · UCSF Illinois Street Garage: The garage's opening milestone was dated May 2023 although its own text said only the year is used; it is now dated 2023 and notes that the UCSF Real Estate page behind it returns 403. Clark Construction's readable release confirms the 9-level, 500-space garage on Block 34 but not the 590 Illinois St address or the opening date, which remain open questions on the record. The Commons photo credit no longer says it was taken from a departing flight.

item.title: Complete · UCSF Illinois Street Garage: Illinois Street Garage (9 stories, 500 cars) is reported open by this date: SF YIMBY's article of February 8, 2023 calls it "the now-open nine-story parking garage at the corner of 3rd and Mariposa Street". The date it opened is not known: UCSF Real Estate's project page, which is reported to give May 15, 2023, returned HTTP 403, so that date is not shown (~2023)

item.title: Under construction · UCSF Illinois Street Garage: Construction begins on the Illinois Street Garage portion of the Block 34 project specifically (500 spaces, nine levels), per Clark Construction's own press release: "Clark started construction on the garage portion of the development in April 2021" -- distinct from the clinical building's groundbreaking, which Clark announced in the same release on September 23, 2021 (Apr 2021)
